mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average and remains below for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
